thread:
incident-bot: PAGER: detected sustained GPU capacity exhaustion in aws-us-west-2 (autoscaler stalled). queue_length per pool > 4k, enqueue rate +120% in last 5m. severity=P1. runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gpu-quota

olivia: acked. I'm on it, switching to bridge. pls post impact and recent metrics.

raj: seeing queued requests rising on pool gpu-pool-usw2-primary. autoscaler logs show repeated 'quotaExceeded' errors when attempting to create nodes: 
```
ERROR Provisioner: CreateInstances failed: InsufficientInstanceCapacity: Requested 8 x n1-standard-16 with NVIDIA T4 - quota exceeded
HTTP 403 QuotaExceeded: quota 'GPUS' exceeded for project 12345
```

olivia: confirmed. Customer-facing APIs are returning 502/timeout for ~3% of requests routed to us-west-2, and token-level latency p95 jumped to ~2.3s overall. Maria, any customer tickets?

maria: got three support tickets mentioning "slow responses" from customers on us-west. One on playground experienced failed model loads. Notified account team for impacted enterprise customers.

tess: looks like the autoscaler attempted to spin up 24 new GPUs across 3 node groups and all attempts failed with quota denial from AWS. The fallback pool (warm-pool-usw2) is already drained.

leo: I just checked IAM/project quotas — the project has 0 available T4 quota in us-west-2, used==limit. We have spare quotas in eu-west-1 and us-east-1 but cross-region cold start would take ~90-120s.

olivia: mitigation plan: 1) throttle background/low-priority buckets, 2) ensure routing policy starts failing over to us-east-1 for latency-insensitive customers, 3) engage cloud quota request and AWS support, 4) handoff if needed. Starting step 1 now.

raj: throttling non-critical batch jobs and retrys set to backoff. Pushing a temporary policy change: reduce batch_size from 8->4 for generation jobs to lower GPU pressure. Config snippet: 
```
route: generation
priority: high
batch_size: 4  # temporary
```

tess: applied routing override for routes flagged 'non-urgent'. Patch pushed to feature flags. Will monitor queue.

leo: filed quota increase request with AWS support (case #12345678). ETA uncertain, but I also submitted an emergency increase form. Copying AWS reply: "We can expedite for critical production impact; please provide justification and expected usage."

maria: posting update to the status page: "We are experiencing elevated errors and latency for requests served from us-west-2 due to GPU provisioning limits. We are throttling non-critical workloads and routing some traffic to other regions."
